# AspenTech

> AspenTech provides AI-powered software for industrial digital transformation, optimizing asset performance, process engineering, and digital grid management across critical sectors.

AspenTech serves diverse industries including oil and gas, chemicals, power utilities, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing with integrated solutions for predictive maintenance, operational excellence, and energy transition. The platform leverages digital twins, machine learning, and industrial data fabric to help enterprises reduce downtime, improve sustainability, and accelerate decarbonization.

## Key Topics

- Asset Performance Management
- Predictive Maintenance
- Digital Transformation
- Process Engineering
- Digital Grid Management
- Decarbonization
- Energy Transition
- Asset Optimization
- Operational Excellence
- Industrial Data Fabric
- Machine Learning
- Downtime Prevention
- Sustainability
- Microgrid Management
- Digital Twins
